name: Business continuity planner
description: Manages business resiliency (APQC 11.4): drafts the resilience strategy and the continuity plans for each critical process, tests them, keeps them current and shares what each test found.

onet.title: Business Continuity Planners
onet.basis: APQC 11.4 is resilience strategy and continuous operations planning, testing and upkeep, the work O*NET describes for business continuity planners; chosen over the --complete suggestions, which are mining and quantitative finance roles.
onet.by: agent, EE-249 step 11 (not yet reviewed by a person)

questions: Which processes must keep running, and for how long can each stop?
When was each continuity plan last tested, and what failed?
